records.name: Dex Semantics
records.tagline: Let your agent build analytics with 25% fewer errors
records.description: Dex Semantics adds declarations to your analytical models, which capture row meaning, join nature, how numbers add up, and decisional assumptions. Thanks to this, Dex scores 80% on ADE-bench with Claude Sonnet 5.5, compared to 73.3% without Dex (25% fewer tasks failed). Declarations live in your models as code, not a third-party tool. Dex then helps your agent convert declarations into your Semantic Layer of choice.

records.name: Uber Parking
records.tagline: Find, compare and reserve parking inside the Uber app
records.description: Uber Parking lets you find, compare and reserve parking right in the Uber app. Unlike circling the block or juggling a separate parking app, you enter a destination and time, see lots and garages on a map with upfront prices, filter by valet, self-park or amenities, and pay with Uber Wallet. Scan a QR code or drive in with plate recognition, extend from your phone if you run late. 13,000+ garages, lots and valets in 400 US and Canadian cities. Uber One members get 10% back.

records.name: HiringNow
records.tagline: AI job agent that finds & apply for jobs before anyone else.
records.description: HiringNow checks 247,000+ company career sites every 5 minutes, so you see new jobs before they hit the big boards. It matches each job to your profile, tailors your resume and cover letter, and applies on the employer's own site, only with your approval. Every application gets a receipt in your job tracker. Also: resume builder and mock interviews. Free plan with 10 auto-applies.

records.name: CaptureFlow
records.tagline: Open-source screen recorder with instant share links
records.description: Record your screen with the Chrome extension and share a link with your team or customers. Your AI agents can record too, through the MCP server: demos, how-tos and bug reports.

records.name: inread.app
records.tagline: your newsletters, outside your inbox
records.description: inread gives you a private @inread.app address just for newsletters. They land in a clean, tracker-free reader instead of your inbox. Highlight what matters and take it to Obsidian, Readwise or any notes app in Markdown.

records.name: Antelog
records.tagline: Stops AI coding agents from leaking or destroying your data
records.description: AI coding agents are amazing. Until one deletes your database, or leaks your secrets. Antelog stops the disasters before they happen, and shows you everything your AI did: every command, every website, every bit of data it sent. Works with Claude Code, Cursor and Codex. Free.

records.name: Tacie
records.tagline: Meeting notes on your Mac, with no bot in the call
records.description: Someone asks, "Why did we decide this?" and no one remembers. The answer is somewhere in a doc from months ago. Tacie listens on your Mac, with no bot in the call. When a question like that comes up, it looks up the answer in your past meetings and connected tools like Notion, Jira and Linear, and shows the answer and its source during the meeting. When the meeting ends, Tacie writes up the decisions, to-dos and open questions.

records.name: Gemini Robotics 2.5
records.tagline: Gemini Robotics 2.5: Google’s most capable robot model
records.description: Gemini Robotics 2.5 is Google DeepMind’s most capable vision-language-action model, turning what a robot sees and is told into hand and arm movements. Per DeepMind, it has a 30% to 100% higher success rate than the previous baseline, finishes tasks 20% to 30% faster, and reached 96% success in a Mercedes-Benz parts-kitting pilot with Apptronik’s Apollo 2 humanoid. Works across robot types. Rolling out to robotics partners.

records.name: Restoration Scope
records.tagline: Field data and monitoring software for reforestation
records.description: Restoration Scope is field data and monitoring software for reforestation, nature restoration and carbon projects. Field teams record plots, plantings, survival and geotagged photos on their phones, offline too. We set up maps, dashboards and data quality checks, and public portals for funders. Carbon developers keep the plot records their verifier checks. Used by One Tree Planted, Acción Andina, One Acre Fund and Ponterra. Free pilot on a sample of your data; no per-user or per-hectare fees.

records.name: Dynamic Edge
records.tagline: The Dynamic Island for Windows
records.description: Dynamic Edge brings a Dynamic Island-style experience to Windows 10 and 11. It combines media controls, clipboard history, app and folder launching, timers, volume controls, and more into a lightweight floating interface. Built with native WinUI 3 and Windows App SDK, it is designed to feel at home on Windows without the overhead of Electron. You can dock it to the top, left, or right of your screen, use it across multiple monitors, and quickly summon it with a global hotkey or Magic Shake.

records.name: Replay
records.tagline: Mac meeting recorder with no bot. Pay once, no subscription
records.description: Replay records your Google Meet, Zoom and Teams calls right from your Mac, so no notetaker bot joins the call and nobody has to let one in. Your voice and theirs land on separate tracks, and the transcript, summary and action items are made on your Mac. Recordings stay local in ordinary files, and you can search every past meeting. Pay once, activate two Macs, no subscription. Needs Apple silicon and macOS 26 or later.

records.name: ScreenGo
records.tagline: screen recorder for Mac with auto zooms and virtual webcam
records.description: A Mac screen recorder with a camera bubble, teleprompter and an editor that does the polish for you: zooms, cursor, captions and clean sound. No account, nothing leaves your Mac.

records.name: VB Notes
records.tagline: Markdown notes in your own folder, searched by meaning
records.description: A free, open-source notes app for iPhone, Android, Mac, Windows and Linux. Every note is a plainmd file in a folder you choose, edited in a Bear-style editor with nested tags. Search by meaning runs on the device, offline. No account.

records.name: Horef Rings
records.tagline: Any metric on any Apple Watch face, plus a daily score
records.description: Put any of 75 metrics on any watch face as a complication, or three in one field. Plus iPhone widgets and Headroom, a daily 0–10 score from your sleep and vitals. Free to try, one-time Pro, no account, no ads.

records.name: AnyoneHiring.today
records.tagline: A world map of jobs. “Anywhere” is now a plan.
records.description: See who’s hiring worldwide. Filter by city, pay, or work style, then sign in to open the original listing. There are paid gigs too, because rent doesn’t care about your five-year plan.

records.name: Drops
records.tagline: Discover new music through moments your friends love
records.description: Drops is a social music discovery app from HARMAN, the company behind JBL. Explore 10–30-second moments from songs, handpicked by people who love them. Discover new artists, follow people whose taste you trust, react to their picks, and save your favorites to Droplists. Every Drop combines music, lyrics, artwork, and a personal story about why that moment matters. Find your next favorite song through people, not just playlists.

records.name: Thunder
records.tagline: A blazing-fast, persistent, key-value AI workload database
records.description: Thunder is a blazing-fast, persistent, and scalable key-value database built in Rust for modern, data-intensive applications. Designed from the ground up for high throughput, low latency, and efficient resource utilization, Thunder uses a shard-per-core architecture to scale with CPU cores while minimizing contention. Unlike traditional in-memory databases, Thunder combines the performance of modern NVMe storage with intelligent memory management.

records.name: CodeMesh
records.tagline: Cut AI coding costs by 90%
records.description: CodeMesh helps AI coding tools like Claude Code, Cursor, and Windsurf understand your code faster. Instead of reading the same files again and again, CodeMesh gives them only the code they need. This can reduce token usage and AI costs by over 90%, while making coding agents faster and more efficient. You keep using your favorite coding tool CodeMesh simply makes it smarter and cheaper.

records.name: Valutorio
records.tagline: Your Markdown notes, native on Mac and iPhone
records.description: Free Mac and iPhone app that opens the Markdown vault you already keep, nothing to import. Wikilinks, backlinks, search, daily notes, a graph on the Mac. Sync ($5.99/mo) keeps Mac and iPhone the same and lets your AI read and write your notes over MCP.

records.name: Tabletop by Google Labs
records.tagline: Build interactive group experiences with AI.
records.description: Create custom interactive tools for trips, games, events, and group activities with AI. Plan, collaborate, and make decisions together in real time.

records.name: MAP & GO!
records.tagline: See your day on the map
records.description: MAP & GO! puts your day on the map: tasks and events land on a place, weather sits on the pin, and AI is one tap away, so you can find a place, look around, and navigate without leaving the app, with Apple and Google connected.

records.name: Businesses in ChatGPT
records.tagline: Help customers discover your business through ChatGPT
records.description: Discover how customers find your business in ChatGPT. Claim your business profile, manage information, explore insights, and create a Business Agent if eligible

records.name: Blender 5.3
records.tagline: 3D Gaussian splats, now native to Blender
records.description: Blender 5.3 adds native 3D Gaussian Splats across Geometry Nodes, Workbench, EEVEE, and Cycles, alongside DLSS 4.5 viewport denoising, optional Project setups, Compositor scene effects, Material Lighting nodes, and ripple video editing.

records.name: FreeFlow Dictation
records.tagline: On-device Mac dictation with a Claude Code voice hook
records.description: Hold ⌥, speak, release: text lands in any Mac app, transcribed on the Neural Engine. No account, no cloud, no telemetry. Connect Claude Code and answer its plans and questions by voice from a card. 14-day trial, then $99 once for 3 Macs.

records.name: Aboard Sign
records.tagline: Email a contract, CC sign@aboard.com and collect signatures
records.description: Get a contract signed with no account or app: email it to everyone who signs, CC sign@aboard.com, and each person gets a link to read and sign it in the browser. Everyone is mailed the signed PDF, every page cryptographically signed. The document isn't kept.

records.name: Nexus
records.tagline: One visual graph for all your projects
records.description: Nexus maps your software projects and every service they depend on in one visual graph. Click any node to open its dashboard. No account needed, your data stays in your browser. Free for up to 3 projects.

records.name: Kokonut UI
records.tagline: Open-source UI components for your AI agent
records.description: Kokonut UI is a free, MIT-licensed library of 100+ React components made for coding agents. Connect through MCP in Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code or Codex, ask for "a tool approval card in my chat", and your agent finds the component, installs it and edits it in your repo. Every docs page is also served as Markdown for agents. This release adds 65 components and rebuilds 34, led by AI chat parts: tool calls, tool approval, diff review, citations and more.

records.name: Default Tamer
records.tagline: Open every link in the right browser on macOS
records.description: Tired of Slack opening work links in Safari? Default Tamer routes every link to the right browser or profile on macOS. • Source apps: Slack to Chrome, Cursor to Firefox • Domain and URL rules, including browser profiles • Hold Option to pick a browser instantly • 100% local, no tracking, under 1ms Free and open source. Optional Power plan for profiles, private windows, and shortcuts.

records.name: Pixel UI
records.tagline: Free, Open-source animated React components.
records.description: Free, open-source animated React components built with Tailwind CSS and Motion. Install via shadcn or MCP, copy into your codebase, and own every frame.

records.name: SingSpree
records.tagline: Free online karaoke
records.description: Free online karaoke: 30,000+ songs with synced lyrics, real-time pitch scoring and multiplayer karaoke parties.

records.name: Replay
records.tagline: Mac meeting recorder with no bot. Pay once, no subscription
records.description: Replay records your Google Meet, Zoom and Teams calls right from your Mac, so no notetaker bot joins the call and nobody has to let one in. Your voice and theirs land on separate tracks, and the transcript, summary and action items are made on your Mac. Recordings stay local in ordinary files, and you can search every past meeting. Pay once, activate two Macs, no subscription. Needs Apple silicon and macOS 26 or later.

records.name: Flame: Dating, Chat & Live
records.tagline: Meet real people, chat instantly, and go live.
records.description: Flame — ignite the fire of true feelings! 🔥 Looking for love, new friends or just interesting communication? Flame is not just a dating app, it is a place where every couple starts with sincere sympathy, and communication becomes an exciting adventure. We created an app that helps people find each other faster, safer and more interesting. Forget about endless empty profiles — Flame is full of living energy! Why is Flame your perfect choice?

records.name: Antelog
records.tagline: Stops AI coding agents from leaking or destroying your data
records.description: AI coding agents are amazing. Until one deletes your database, or leaks your secrets. Antelog stops the disasters before they happen, and shows you everything your AI did: every command, every website, every bit of data it sent. Works with Claude Code, Cursor and Codex. Free.

records.name: Kalima
records.tagline: Transcribe and translate every conversation, anywhere
records.description: Live transcription and translation in 60 languages with the highest accuracy. Meetings, calls, lectures or face to face, on your phone or computer. • Two-way translation • Automatic meeting detection • AI summary and tasks • Records sound from any app

records.name: Duvidha
records.tagline: A 5-day Bhagavad Gita journey from dilemma to decision
records.description: Stuck between two choices? Type your dilemma and Duvidha shows the one Bhagavad Gita verse that speaks to it, the Mahabharata character who faced a moment like yours, and practical steps for today. Free, no sign-up. Then take a 5-day guided journey in English or Hinglish that ends with Your Nishchay, a one-page decision summary written from your own answers. Day 1 free, full journey ₹99.

records.name: ClassPulse: gpa & Study Planner
records.tagline: Syllabus Scanner, GPA Tracker & Study Planner
records.description: ClassPulse turns a course syllabus into a planned semester. Scan the syllabus once and it extracts every deadline, calculates the score needed to hit a target grade, tracks GPA across US 4.0, Canadian 4.33, UK honours and European ECTS scales, and builds a study plan around the hours actually available.

records.name: Unique Visitors Counter - npm package
records.tagline: A tiny, privacy-first way to count unique visitors.
records.description: Add a lifetime visitor count to your website with one npm install and a few lines of code. Works with React or plain JavaScript. It uses a random browser ID stored in local storage—no cookies, IP tracking, or browser fingerprinting. best for small websites -portfolios -one page websites --------------------------------------------------------------------- npm install unique-visitor-counter import { VisitorCount } from 'unique-visitor-counter/react';

records.name: Seekpitch
records.tagline: AI SDR that finds leads and writes the cold emails
records.description: Paste your website. Seekpitch researches your market, finds leads that fit your offer and shows why each one is worth contacting. It writes short cold emails from your facts and sends from your own mailboxes. Nothing sends without your OK. Free for 30 days.

records.name: BaseHalf
records.tagline: Open a folder as a canvas, with your AI agents beside it
records.description: Keep what you and your AI agents work out in one folder you can see. BaseHalf opens a folder as a canvas, and every file in it is a card: notes, PDFs, books, images, video, code. A line from a card to a note is saved as plain text in the note, so it shows up in git. Claude Code, Codex or any terminal agent works beside the canvas on the same files and knows which card you mean by "this". Generate images, video and sound with your own API keys. No account. Free and open source.

records.name: Blaha for Vikunja
records.tagline: A planner for Vikunja, not just a list
records.description: Blaha is a planner for Vikunja on iPhone, iPad, Mac and Android. Your tasks stay on your own server; Blaha adds the system: defer dates, so work stays hidden until its date, a review cycle per project, perspectives of your own, and a Forecast that puts your calendar beside what is due. Projects, folders, tags, a timer with hourly rates, and an Apple Watch app. Nothing to sign up for. Free as a full task client, with a one-time unlock for the planning features and a 7-day trial.

records.name: ScreenGo
records.tagline: screen recorder for Mac with auto zooms and virtual webcam
records.description: A Mac screen recorder with a camera bubble, teleprompter and an editor that does the polish for you: zooms, cursor, captions and clean sound. No account, nothing leaves your Mac.

records.name: OYNA
records.tagline: AI family app that turns kids' habits into quests
records.description: OYNA helps parents of kids 7–16 build good habits without nagging. Parents set quests or simply describe them to Jey, our AI helper. Kids complete them in their own app with a photo report, parents approve, and kids earn coins for rewards the parents choose. Jey also chats with kids within safe daily limits and suggests quests that fit each child. Made for families in Central Asia. Free for one child; Premium adds up to 4 kids and a second parent.

records.name: DAXORA
records.tagline: AI tools that turn business data into dashboards
records.description: DAXORA turns business data into working dashboards in minutes instead of weeks. DAXORA Insight generates complete dashboard applications from your data. DAXORA Forge converts existing Power BI, Tableau and Qlik Sense reports into native dashboards. DAXORA Studio builds AI-assisted ETL pipelines to prepare the data. Each product works on its own, as cloud SaaS or on-premises.

records.name: inread.app
records.tagline: your newsletters, outside your inbox
records.description: inread gives you a private @inread.app address just for newsletters. They land in a clean, tracker-free reader instead of your inbox. Highlight what matters and take it to Obsidian, Readwise or any notes app in Markdown.

records.name: CaptureFlow
records.tagline: Open-source screen recorder with instant share links
records.description: Record your screen with the Chrome extension and share a link with your team or customers. Your AI agents can record too, through the MCP server: demos, how-tos and bug reports.

records.name: Vita AI
records.tagline: iPhone AI agent that does the errands you keep putting off
records.description: Vita is a personal AI agent for iPhone. Tell it what you need in a sentence and it gets on with it. It plans a trip down to the leave-by alert and the alarm, reads the store pages and the reviews before you buy, keeps watch on a parcel or a refund, and remembers what you tell it. It asks before anything is bought, booked or agreed to. In the US it can also make the phone call for you while you read it live. Free in beta, no sign-up.

records.name: GeoLearn Kids
records.tagline: 100% Free interactive world map quiz
records.description: A 100% free, ad-free geography web app for kids and classrooms. Explore an interactive world atlas, daily mystery country quiz, flag battle, and native audio across 7 languages. Zero tracking, no login required, and COPPA compliant.

records.name: Midmap
records.tagline: A shared information space for working with your AI agent
records.description: AI agents can produce more than a chat can comfortably hold: useful ideas get buried, decisions blur, and changes are hard to check. Midmap gives you and your agent an independent information space for complex research, planning, and creative work. The agent organizes work into a visual map; you review each round of changes, leave feedback, and keep or undo edits. Move from chasing chat history to a clear, reviewable loop—so you stay oriented and in control.

records.name: FinCatch
records.tagline: FinCatch connects firms and financial events across time
records.description: Financial events rarely make sense in isolation. A supplier disruption, a change in guidance, and an earnings update months later may all be connected. Understanding those connections takes a view of how the story developed over time. Our temporal knowledge graph connects companies, events, and relationships across time. The graph now contains over 2.4 million nodes, and we process an average of 15,000 events per day. We’ve added API & MCP support, so agents can access the same research data.

records.name: Uber Parking
records.tagline: Find, compare and reserve parking inside the Uber app
records.description: Uber Parking lets you find, compare and reserve parking right in the Uber app. Unlike circling the block or juggling a separate parking app, you enter a destination and time, see lots and garages on a map with upfront prices, filter by valet, self-park or amenities, and pay with Uber Wallet. Scan a QR code or drive in with plate recognition, extend from your phone if you run late. 13,000+ garages, lots and valets in 400 US and Canadian cities. Uber One members get 10% back.

records.name: RentDera - Rent Management
records.tagline: Manage Rentals. Simplify Life. Your Rentals, Under Control.
records.description: RentDera is the landlord app for managing rental properties without spreadsheets, sticky notes, or WhatsApp chaos. Add each property and its units once, then track everything that matters day to day: RentDera does not move money for you — rent is still paid the way you already collect it, whether that is a bank transfer, cash, or mobile wallet. What RentDera replaces is the manual bookkeeping around it: the notebook, the missed dues, the "did they already pay this month?" guesswork.

records.name: Denizen Blu
records.tagline: Affordable AI Solutions for Businesses | Denizen Blu
records.description: Denizen Blu delivers affordable AI solutions for businesses, combining advanced AI models, scalable infrastructure, and developer-friendly tools to boost productivity, simplify workflows, and accelerate digital transformation.

records.name: RewatchKit
records.tagline: Build playlists from parts of different YouTube videos
records.description: Choose start and end points in different YouTube videos to build a playlist. RewatchKit automatically plays only those sections, one after another, in your chosen order. Repeat a section or add notes that take you back to the right moment. A Chrome extension that saves timestamps, not video files. No account required.

records.name: The Outdoor Oath
records.tagline: Hard Coolers built for the rugged Australian Environment
records.description: Premium Outdoor gear. Aussie Born. Built to explore. The Outdoor Oath is a lifestyle pledge. It is about making the most of every sunrise, chasing new experiences, and reconnecting with nature in its purest form. Stainless Steel Drinkware and Hard Coolers built for the rugged Australian Environment.

records.name: TernaryWire
records.tagline: A lightweight native API client, a Postman alternative
records.description: A native API client written entirely in Rust: no Electron, no account, first frame in about 40 ms. HTTP, GraphQL, gRPC, WebSocket, Socket.IO, MQTT, SOAP, MCP and AI requests in one app. Postman collections, environments and pm.* scripts import and run unchanged. Git-friendly workspaces with secrets in the keychain, a collection runner and a newman-compatible CLI for CI, visual Flows, Spec Hub for OpenAPI, plus a local mock server. Free and open source.

records.name: weedit Exit Popup
records.tagline: This app allows you to show attention-grabbing exit popups
records.description: With this app, you can set up a customizable popup that appears based on various triggers. For example, it can show when a visitor is about to leave the store, after they’ve spent a set amount of time on the page, or once they’ve scrolled through a certain portion of the content. It can also activate after a period of visitor inactivity or after a user has viewed a specific number of pages. This flexibility makes it a powerful tool for engaging customers at the right moment.

records.name: VB Notes
records.tagline: Markdown notes in your own folder, searched by meaning
records.description: A free, open-source notes app for iPhone, Android, Mac, Windows and Linux. Every note is a plainmd file in a folder you choose, edited in a Bear-style editor with nested tags. Search by meaning runs on the device, offline. No account.

records.name: ShopSEO Pro
records.tagline: AI SEO titles, descriptions, and keywords for web stores
records.description: AI-powered SEO titles, descriptions, and keyword suggestions for Etsy, Shopify, and Amazon sellers. Try three free generations.

records.name: Horef Rings
records.tagline: Any metric on any Apple Watch face, plus a daily score
records.description: Put any of 75 metrics on any watch face as a complication, or three in one field. Plus iPhone widgets and Headroom, a daily 0–10 score from your sleep and vitals. Free to try, one-time Pro, no account, no ads.

records.name: Hamsty
records.tagline: The clipboard manager that lives in your MacBook's notch
records.description: Hamsty remembers everything you copy (text, links, images, files) and finds it in a keystroke, even text inside screenshots. Drop files on the notch shelf, paste in sequence, use snippets. Encrypted on your Mac, zero telemetry. Free.

records.name: Hydra – Water Tracker
records.tagline: Water tracking that counts what your body actually keeps
records.description: Hydra tracks net hydration: coffee, milk and alcohol count by how much water your body keeps. Meet Sippy, a water drop that fills up as you drink. Your goal adapts to workouts and the weather. Apple Watch app and widgets. No account, no ads.

records.name: Taghazout.io
records.tagline: Plan surf stays and local life on Morocco’s coast
records.description: Surf stays, yoga, coworking and local experiences in Taghazout & Tamraght. Guides, forecasts, trip planning and partner tools in 10 languages. Availability checked before a reviewed booking quote.

records.name: LabFlow
records.tagline: Lab software for concrete, asphalt and soil testing
records.description: LabFlow is a laboratory information management system (LIMS) for construction materials testing laboratories - concrete, asphalt, aggregates, soil and steel. It tracks samples from collection to report with chain of custody, schedules concrete break ages, calculates results for EN and ISO test methods, issues versioned PDF reports, gives clients a portal, and handles quotes and invoices.

records.name: Weydr
records.tagline: Tailor your resume to every job, without inventing a thing
records.description: Weydr turns one master profile of your real experience into a resume, cover letter and interview prep tailored to each job. Paste a job description to see your fit score and gaps, then get a rewritten resume that only uses facts you've provided, never invented skills or numbers. Includes 15+ ATS-safe templates, STAR interview answers from your own work, salary ranges with negotiation scripts, and a tracker for every application. Free to start, no card needed.

records.name: SAMA Entreprise
records.tagline: Sales, stock, invoicing and payroll for West African SMEs
records.description: SAMA Entreprise brings sales, checkout, stock, invoices, customer credit, payroll and OHADA accounting into one tool for shops and SMEs in West Africa. It works in CFA francs and accepts Wave, Orange Money and other mobile money payments.

records.name: Laos Now
records.tagline: laos
records.description: Laos Now helps you plan each day in Laos around the weather, local traditions and the places worth visiting. Switch the whole app between English and Lao at any time. Signing in is optional. The main features work without an account. Questions or feedback? Email support@laosnow.org or visit laosnow.org.

records.name: Mirayne: Daily Habit Tracker
records.tagline: Build daily habits and stay consistent effortlessly
records.description: Mirayne: Daily Habit Tracker helps you build better habits, track your progress, and stay consistent every day. Organize your habits in a simple, clear, and elegant space designed to make your daily routine easier to follow. Create and manage your habits Create daily, weekly, or selected-day habits. Mark habits as completed, skipped, or missed. Edit, archive, and reactivate habits whenever you need. Track your current streaks and longest streaks.

records.name: TypingImprove
records.tagline: Free Online Typing Tests to Improve Speed and Accuracy
records.description: TypingImprove is a free online typing platform designed to help students, professionals, and beginners improve their typing speed and accuracy. Take online typing tests, measure your WPM, check your accuracy, and practise at your own pace. Whether you're learning touch typing or preparing for a typing skills test, TypingImprove makes it easy to track your progress and build better typing habits.

records.name: BatiTrust
records.tagline: Run building projects from first quote to final invoice
records.description: BatiTrust brings site tracking, lot-based quotes and invoicing into one tool, from the first quote to the final balance. Built for French project managers, architects, general contractors and renovation brokers. Craftsmen and clients join each project for free, with no limit. Deposits, progress invoices, credit notes and e-invoicing (Factur-X) included. French interface, three plans, demo on request.

records.name: Nikke Scribe
records.tagline: Transcribe 10-hour WAV files. No subscription required.
records.description: Why pay for a monthly subscription just to transcribe a few recordings? Most transcription services lock you into recurring plans, even when you only need them occasionally. Nikke Scribe offers a simpler alternative. Transcribe up to 10 hours of audio or video in a single file, with AI-powered transcription delivered in seconds. Pay only when you need it. No subscriptions, no recurring fees, no wasted credits. Built for interviews, meetings, podcasts, lectures, and other long recordings.

records.name: Neo Puzzles
records.tagline: Calm neon puzzles for your coffee break. No ads, no sign-up
records.description: Puzzle games without the noise: no ads, no timers, no sign-up. Trace figures in one line, connect pipes, sort aliens or sharpen your focus with quick memory games, all in one neon world. A new Daily Puzzle every day, and a free hint whenever you get stuck.

records.name: PrinterIQ Finder
records.tagline: Find the right printer in 60 seconds
records.description: PrinterIQ Finder is a free quiz that helps you choose a printer. Answer seven plain-language questions about what you print, how much, and your budget. In about 60 seconds you get three recommended printers, each with a short reason why it fits. No sign-up, no ads, no affiliate links. Results link to matching ink and toner on castleink.com. Site owners can embed the finder with three lines of HTML. Made by Castle Ink.

records.name: MY: Live Wallpapers
records.tagline: 200+ Material Expressive Live Animated Wallpapers
records.description: Your wallpaper shouldn’t just look good. It should bring your entire phone to life. Meet MY: Live Wallpapers, a collection of 200+ animated Material You wallpapers that turn your home screen into something personal, colorful, and alive. Explore beautifully animated shapes, watch them move and react to your touch, and give your phone a look that feels uniquely yours. Build ypout own animated Material You wallpapers from scratch or start with a ready-made template.

records.name: First Spoon: Baby Food Tracker
records.tagline: Starting solids & allergens
records.description: Starting solids shouldn't feel like a test. First Spoon is a calm, day-by-day roadmap for introducing your baby's first foods — one food at a time, at your baby's own pace. Whether you follow purées or baby-led weaning, First Spoon shows you what's ready to try, what's coming up next, and what your baby has already tried — so you never have to guess or keep notes on scraps of paper.

records.name: Text Repeater
records.tagline: Repeat text instantly.

It belongs to the Euphorbiaceae family.

records.name: Aptile

No labels, no profile shown to you — just a path that fits how you actually learn. Built on research from Aptitude-Treatment Interaction (ATI) studies.

Instead of writing what you still have to do, you note what you did: “walked 30 minutes”, “fixed the login bug”, “called Mom”. Small things count. Unfinished things count. Resting counts.

records.tagline: Know your vendors: background checks and breach alerts
records.description: VendorCat runs a background check on every vendor you pay: owner, SEC filings, sanctions, breaches, exploited flaws, website age. Then it sends you short headlines when they get breached, go down or get acquired. Free for 10 vendors.

records.name: SkleUp CRM
records.tagline: SkleUp is all-in-one CRM software for Indian businesses
records.description: SkleUp is an all-in-one CRM for Indian businesses: lead management, sales pipeline and proposals, task and time tracking, HRMS with attendance and payroll, and GST-ready accounting in one login.

records.name: Prevo
records.tagline: Visa, Citizenship & Interview Prep
records.description: Practice high-stakes interviews before it matters. Visa, US citizenship, business pitch, and job interviews — with voice AI, a readiness score, and a free quiz mode.

records.name: Layouta
records.tagline: AI Product Image Generator for Amazon and Shopify
records.description: An AI Product Image Generator that turns product photos into listing images and copy for Amazon, Shopify, and more. You confirm the plan, then edit and export.

records.name: Kwiz.tv
records.tagline: Host live quizzes your teams answer on their phones
records.description: Turn any quiz night into a game show. Put questions and live scores on the big screen while teams answer from their phones. No app to download, just join and play. Built for pubs, offices, fundraisers and family nights.

records.name: SkleUp CRM
records.tagline: BUILD AUTOMATE GROW
records.description: One CRM for Indian businesses to manage leads, sales, team and accounts in a single login. Track leads and pipelines, send proposals, manage tasks, run HRMS with attendance and payroll, create GST invoices, and follow up on WhatsApp. 50 hours free Customisation.

records.name: Lemma
records.tagline: Lemma checks your proof like a careful TA
records.description: Lemma checks your proof like a careful TA. It finds the first line that doesn't follow, and it won't hand you the answer.

records.name: PRISMINTEL
records.tagline: Geopolitical & Market Intelligence OSINT Terminal
records.description: Unbiased multi-bloc synthesis with media, markets, lobbying, energy and OSINT lenses.

records.name: Job Alert
records.tagline: Daily verified sarkari job alerts for Karnataka & all India
records.description: Job Alert gives daily verified government job alerts, results, admit cards, answer keys and schemes — 7th/8th/10th/12th pass, ITI, Diploma, Degree and PG jobs across Karnataka and all India. KPSC, KEA, Police, Railway, Bank, Teacher, Anganwadi and Forest recruitments, updated daily.

records.name: Auryx
records.tagline: The free gym tracker that tells you if you’re progressing
records.description: Auryx shows your last performance and a target to beat before every set, then tells you which exercises are progressing, stable or need attention, with the reason. Free on iPhone, no subscription, no AI. French-language app.

records.name: Deletely
records.tagline: Clean up your camera roll. Nothing is preselected.
records.description: Deletely helps you clear screenshots, screen recordings, similar and old photos, and large videos on iPhone. Swipe or review in a grid, and nothing is preselected. It runs on-device with no account. Free to download; deleting needs Pro.

records.name: ArtiRead
records.tagline: Learn German through stories you'll actually want to read
records.description: Level-appropriate German articles (A1–C1) with tap-to-translate, listen-along audio, grammar in context and quizzes. Read German stories, tap any word for its meaning.

records.name: Interlude
records.tagline: Find coffee, food & sights that fit between two plans
records.description: Got an hour between plans? Tell Interlude where you're headed and when you need to be there. It finds coffee, food, bars and sights right on your way, with walk, drive or rideshare times for both legs of the trip. Free, no account, no tracking.

records.name: Yellow: Slow Your Scroll
records.tagline: The dumbphone alternative for people who need their iPhone
records.description: Keep Maps, Uber and Apple Pay. Yellow puts a math problem before the apps you open on autopilot; they open for 3, 5, 10 or 15 minutes, then lock again. iPhone only. 7-day trial, then $29.99/yr or $5.99/mo.

records.name: Yappium
records.tagline: Free chat with voice and video that you can host yourself
records.description: Yappium is chat for communities and friends: text channels, forums, voice, video and screen share, in a browser or the Windows app, with push-to-talk that works while you're in a game. It's free, with no ads and no selling of your data, and you never have to show your face or ID. Anyone can run their own Yappium server for free on Linux, Windows or Docker and open it from the same app. Optional supporter plans start at US$3 a month.

records.name: Captiono
records.tagline: Free AI captions & video translation in 130+ languages
records.description: Captiono writes word-perfect captions for any video and translates them into 130+ languages, timed to the speaker. Pick from 50+ animated templates and 56 fonts, drag captions anywhere, then export an MP4 with captions burned in, plus SRT and VTT files. It runs in your browser: your video never leaves your device, only the audio is sent for transcription. No sign-up, no watermark, no per-minute fees. Works on phones, in 31 languages.

records.name: Punk
records.tagline: Pick any place. Show your ads to devices that were there.
records.description: Punk lets you pick any physical location and show Meta ads to the phones that were physically there IRL. You can advertise straight to people's devices instead of relying on the algorithm to guess who should see your ad.

records.name: ClipIt
records.tagline: Free, ad-free, encrypted clipboard for your VMs and devices
records.description: ClipIt is a free, ad-free online clipboard for moving text, code, screenshots and files (up to 20 MB) between VMs, cloud machines and devices. No sign-up. Everything is encrypted in your browser (AES-256-GCM), so the server only stores ciphertext, and clips auto-delete after 24 hours. Pair a phone by scanning a 3D flower QR code. Built by a software engineer tired of ad-filled, untrustworthy online clipboards.

records.name: Bib Kreyòl Ayisyen
records.tagline: The Haitian Creole Bible app with an intelligent assistant
records.description: Bib Kreyòl Ayisyen is a free Bible app made for Haitian Creole speakers. Read the whole Bible in Kreyòl, get a verse of the day, follow reading plans, add highlights and notes, keep a prayer journal, and turn any verse into an image for your WhatsApp status. Asistan Biblik answers Bible questions in natural Kreyòl, always with verse references. Free on iPhone; Android coming soon on Google Play.

records.name: Gaka
records.tagline: Open your apps and move your windows without a click
records.description: Gaka opens your apps and files and moves your windows without a click. Type a few letters to open anything, press ⌃⌘V for what you copied, and hold ⌘⌃ to move the window under the pointer. Plain AppKit, no Electron. One-time purchase, 14-day free trial.

records.name: ProofCreate
records.tagline: Protect your copyright claim. Keep the record behind it
records.description: Brings creators, their work, and their communities together in one platform. Writers, artists, musicians, photographers, and other creators can build public profiles, connect with audiences, share their work, and document their creative process. Register creative Works, preserve important versions and supporting records, and generate verifiable evidence through Basic Receipts and ProofPackets. Cryptographic fingerprints help establish a reliable record of the files you choose to protect.

records.name: DeltaK
records.tagline: Free NSE & BSE option chains with full Greeks
records.description: DeltaK (say Delta-kay) is an options terminal for Indian index options. Live NSE and BSE option chains for Nifty, Bank Nifty, Fin Nifty, Midcap Nifty, Sensex and Bankex, with delta, gamma, theta, vega and IV on every strike, OI walls, max pain and FII/DII flow. Price a structure in the strategy builder, ask the cash market questions in plain English, and learn payoffs in a free wiki. No sign-in to start. Paper trading only; nothing here is investment advice. Support: support@deltak.in

records.name: PhoneRecap
records.tagline: Your phone year, told as a story — fully offline
records.description: PhoneRecap turns your Android phone use into a short story: total hours, top apps, your phone personality, monthly recaps and shareable cards. It has no internet permission, no account and no analytics — everything stays on your phone.

records.name: Nudgesmart
records.tagline: Free popups, spin wheels & store widgets for Shopify
records.description: Nudgesmart turns Shopify visitors into subscribers and buyers. Pick a ready-made popup (email capture, spin wheel, scratch card, pick-a-present, survey or countdown bar) and add store widgets like free-shipping bars, product labels and sticky add-to-cart. Smart Targeting reads 43 behaviour signals to show each one at the right moment, or you set your own rules. Plus a link-in-bio page on your own store. Discount codes, Klaviyo and Mailchimp built in. Free for a limited time.

records.name: MEDHA – Competitive Exam Prep
records.tagline: Master exam performance through gamified practice
records.description: MEDHA transforms competitive exam preparation into an engaging, gamified performance experience. Go beyond studying with timed challenges, competitive assessments, progress tracking, and performance insights that help you improve speed, accuracy, consistency, and decision-making. With features like Daily Accuracy & Consistency (DAC) and SAMPADA, MEDHA encourages disciplined practice, rewards progress, and makes exam preparation more motivating. MEDHA — Compete. Learn. Grow.

records.name: Zontro
records.tagline: Hire sales reps verified by phone, not just by CV
records.description: EN : French sales recruiting platform. Every candidate and company has a call with our team before getting access, so you only see relevant sales profiles, from SDR to sales director. Post a job, headhunt, or delegate sourcing. FR : Plateforme française de recrutement commercial. Candidats et entreprises passent un appel avec notre équipe avant d'accéder au site : moins de CV hors sujet, du SDR au directeur commercial. Publiez une offre ou déléguez la recherche.

records.name: ARMED
records.tagline: Version history and merging for Ableton Live projects
records.description: A free Mac app that keeps a version of your Live set every time a save changes the music, with a line saying what changed. Go back to any version, keep variations of a song side by side, and merge two of them. Alpha. Audio isn't versioned.

records.name: Mind Pencil
records.tagline: An AI journalist that turns your stories into articles
records.description: You have the stories, the hard-won lessons, the opinions worth sharing. What you don't have is time to face a blank page. Mind Pencil is an AI journalist: it interviews you by voice or text, asks the follow-up a good editor would, and writes a long-form English article in your words. Launch day only: $2.99 at mindpencil.viddastudio.com/?code=HUNT, then $19.99. First draft included. You talk. It asks. Your ideas become stories.

records.name: SpecStream Search API
records.tagline: Live web search API for agents, from $1 per 1,000 searches
records.description: One GET call answers a question from the live web in a few seconds, read at the moment you ask, with the page behind each value. On SimpleQA Verified it scores 99, ahead of Parallel (97), Perplexity (95), Tavily (92) and Exa (91), and it leads all four on WideSearch. $1 per 1,000 searches on the fast tier. Code written for Tavily, Exa, Brave, Serper or Google Custom Search moves by changing the base address and the key. $10 of credit at sign-up, no card.

records.name: slime-pi
records.tagline: A slime that lives in your Raspberry Pi
records.description: Feed it files, say hi over SSH, and read its daily expedition report of your home network. Its mood follows the Pi it lives in, and it steps aside when the Pi runs low on resources. Free and open source.

records.name: Sofft
records.tagline: A social app that slows you down
records.description: Sofft is a free-to-download iPhone app (18+) where you get to know someone through voice notes, written prompts and photos of their life, with no faces on profiles. A face photo can be shared in a chat only after you both say yes to a date. Reporting and blocking are built in. No faces. Just vibes.

records.name: RustAtlas
records.tagline: Find Rust servers, track wipes, and plan your next raid
records.description: RustAtlas helps Rust players find servers, check sampled population history, map locations and wipe estimates, compare options, and save favorites. Built-in raid, CCTV and gene tools help plan your next session. Public read-only APIs and MCP let compatible AI assistants query the same data with source links.

records.name: Hydrolotl
records.tagline: Fun Water Tracker App with a Pet Axolotl
records.description: Hydrolotl is a water tracker for iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch where every drink you log fills a pet axolotl's tank. Steady drinking makes its gills bloom and turns bubbles into pearls; on goal days it lays eggs that hatch into 22 colour morphs. Log from widgets, Siri or your wrist. Works with Apple Health and iCloud; no ads, no tracking, no account.

records.name: Octo
records.tagline: Octo is a private conversation coach
records.description: Octo is a private conversation coach. It listens to your 1:1s and meetings and tells you how you showed up, against principles you write yourself, with one thing to try next time. Free and open source; it runs on your own Mac, and the audio never leaves it.

records.name: Hangout Land
records.tagline: A cozy animated town for background company
records.description: Hangout Land is an always-on animated town with music, characters, and cozy places to spend time. Drop into a diner, beach, park, or radio station while you work or unwind. There’s no plot to follow, just a little background company. The current experience focuses on ambient scenes.

records.name: cutbg
records.tagline: Fit photos and PDFs to any upload form
records.description: Upload form says "max 100 KB" or "600×600 px"? cutbg makes your file fit, right in the browser: compress a photo to an exact size, resize to passport or LinkedIn dimensions, turn iPhone HEIC into JPG, strip GPS metadata, remove a background, merge, split or sign a PDF. 27 tools, and your files never leave your device. Free, no account, no watermark, 17 languages.

records.name: Oasentra
records.tagline: A conversation workspace built for real customer work
records.description: Oasentra brings customer conversations including WhatsApp, CRM, automation, AI, analytics, developer tools, and commerce foundations into one business operating system.

records.name: Spekvia
records.tagline: Learn English through stories, practice and AI conversation
records.description: Build your English from A1 to C2 with 192 story-led lessons connecting words, grammar and practice. Learn 900 core words, save your own, use spaced review and explore interactive word rooms. Practice pronunciation by listening, recording and comparing your voice. Then use what you learn in real-life voice scenes and personalized conversations with Mivo, your AI partner. Start free with one daily voice scene up to 5 minutes; Pro unlocks more.

records.name: Convika
records.tagline: Turn the HTML your AI made into a link anyone can open
records.description: Got an HTML file from ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini? Drop it on Convika and get a link anyone can open on a phone, iPad, or Chromebook, with no app or account. Add a sign-up form and see who visited. New since the June launch: no-signup previews, forms, and visitor stats. In the last 6 weeks, 1,281 people in 101 countries signed up, and ChatGPT sent more of them than Google. Teachers share class games, people send AI-made games to friends, and small teams collect sign-ups.

records.name: ToolsGrid Pay Raise Calculator
records.tagline: Calculate real wage growth and inflation erosion instantly.
records.description: Calculate pay raises, new annual salaries, monthly breakdowns, and hourly rates with real-time inflation erosion adjustments. Calculated in your browser.

records.name: Muscle Max
records.tagline: Level your way up to real strength, one EMOM at a time
records.description: 10-minute EMOM workouts with progressive overload built in. Level up through tiers of push, pull and leg moves, with benchmarks tied to real strength: master the push-up and you can bench 225. Challenge friends to beat your score. Free.

records.name: GodotPrompter
records.tagline: Godot 4 expertise for your AI coding agent
records.description: GodotPrompter is a free, open-source plugin that teaches AI coding agents Godot 4. 59 skills and 9 specialist agents cover architecture, state machines, physics, shaders, UI, multiplayer, web export and more, with GDScript and C# examples checked against Godot 4.3 to 4.7. The agent loads the right skill on demand, so it writes idiomatic Godot 4 code instead of guessing. Works with Claude Code, Copilot CLI, Cursor, Codex, OpenCode, Antigravity and Grok Build.

records.name: MoaBook: Photo Cleanup
records.tagline: Trip albums & fewer duplicates
records.description: MoaBook cleans up your iPhone photo library one trip at a time. It finds your trips from when and where photos were taken, makes an album for each with one tap, and groups similar shots so you keep just the best one. Swipe to sort, shrink videos instead of deleting them, and watch your pixel friend's room get tidier as you go. Everything runs on your device: photos are never sent to a server.

records.name: Voice AI Stage Finder
records.tagline: Know when self-hosting your voice agent starts to pay
records.description: Answer three questions about your calls: minutes a month, platform, and whether a customer has asked where call audio lives. Get your stage on a five-step ladder and your next three steps, emailed as a PDF. The full course behind it is free, no sign-up.

records.name: Fallette
records.tagline: Seasons that fall and pile up on your Mac windows
records.description: Snow, autumn leaves, cherry petals and rain fall over your Mac desktop and pile up on your windows, the Dock and widgets. Sweep a drift and it scatters; drag a window and it slides off. Several themes with 4K wallpapers, scenery and tiny pets. Clicks pass straight through. Free to try, $7.99 once.

records.name: Flyerworks
records.tagline: World’s first AI marketing & design agent for retail.
records.description: Quick commerce moves in minutes, while retail stores lose shoppers waiting days to get an offer designed. Today, days become seconds. Meet Skippi, the world’s first AI agent built exclusively for retail and corner stores. Snap a handwritten price list, paste, or speak it. Skippi turns raw prices into editable flyers and matching shelf tags across 3,000+ designs with zero-hallucination pricing, WhatsApp sharing, and print-ready exports. The corner store is ready to lead again.

records.name: Native Screen
records.tagline: Free, open-source screen recorder for Mac and Windows
records.description: Free, open-source screen recorder and demo video editor, native on macOS and Windows. Zooms follow your clicks, the cursor glides, and a multi-track timeline holds zooms, blur masks, annotations, captions and keyboard shortcuts. Captions, transcript editing and background removal run on your device. No account, no upload, no watermark. AI agents like Claude or Cursor can edit through its MCP server.

records.name: Bamboo Pocket
records.tagline: A quiet forest where you raise a gentle panda at your pace
records.description: Bamboo Pocket is a quiet forest habitat in the browser. You raise a gentle panda at your own pace, including the days you need to be away. Feed a little, stay a little, leave when you need to. One panda $1.99/mo or a pair $2.99/mo, with a 7-day trial.

records.name: Kiri - Focus Timer
records.tagline: Focus timer, tasks and ten sounds in one tab. Pay once.
records.description: Kiri is a focus timer and task list for laptop and desktop, with ten background sounds in the same tab: rain, café, forest, fireplace, sea, wind, waterfall, brown, pink and white noise. No phone app, on purpose. Free tier; €39 once (Founding), then €49.

records.name: LensCap
records.tagline: Free game clip recorder that costs you almost no frames
records.description: LensCap keeps the last few minutes of your game in a rolling buffer encoded on the GPU, so one hotkey saves what already happened. Trim and edit clips in the built-in multi-track editor, share them as a link, or stream live to Twitch and Kick. Recording is free, with no watermark, no ads and no account, on any GPU with a hardware encoder. Built from scratch for Windows, not on top of OBS. Pro (US$5 a month) only raises the sharing limits.

records.name: Webdesly Bijoux
records.tagline: Pieces, clients and private viewings for jewelry maisons
records.description: Quiet floor board for jewelry maisons and advisors: inventory of pieces, client wishlists, and private viewings to confirm or complete on a Today desk. Not a retail POS, not a marketplace. Free Maison Bijoux Demo, no signup.

records.name: Canaryflux
records.tagline: See where your site breaks on iPhone, Pixel and desktop
records.description: Paste a URL. Canaryflux opens it the way an iPhone, a Pixel and a desktop would, and shows you exactly what's broken: clipped buttons, broken images, unreadable text, each with a suggested fix. Free, no account, in a few minutes.

records.name: Friendselfie
records.tagline: Your friends tell you when you were at your best
records.description: Send each friend their own link. They share one moment when you were at your best, in three lines, and pick two strengths. No app, no sign-up. You get a portrait of your strengths in their words, with who named each one. A short test then shows the strength your friends see in you and you don't, and 21 days of 5-minute actions help you use it.

records.name: Drino Shots
records.tagline: App Store & Google Play Screenshot Generator
records.description: Make App Store and Google Play screenshots in your browser: AI-written captions, 50 languages, plus the feature graphic, product page header and search result image, all in one export. Free to start.

records.name: Depder
records.tagline: Turn PDFs and screenshots into flashcards
records.description: Turn your PDFs and screenshots into AI flashcards. Check and edit the cards before saving, then study with scheduled reviews in a calm, focused interface. Bring your existing Anki decks with APKG import, organize decks into folders, and study on iOS or the web. Free to start; Pro adds higher generation limits and Anki export.

records.name: HourFolio
records.tagline: Tap to switch. See where your attention goes.
records.description: HourFolio is an attention ledger for iPhone. There's no start or stop. Tap to switch to what you're doing, in the app or from the Lock Screen and Dynamic Island. Then see the shape of your day, with no score. Plus adds ✦ AI Weekly Insight and the week view.

records.name: Transello - Private AI Translator
records.tagline: Translate any page on-device, or with your own AI key
records.description: Speak fluent internet. Text, selection, whole page in one click, privately or with AI: GPT, Claude, DeepSeek, OpenRouter.

records.name: Where Celebs Go
records.tagline: The restaurants, bars and hotels celebs actually go to
records.description: Where Celebs Go is a guide to the restaurants, bars and hotels famous people go to. Stop going to random places, go where the stars go.

records.name: MPC
records.tagline: Mining real-world assets, verified and on chain
records.description: MPC connects real mining projects with structured data, professional verification and digital registries — the trust layer for mining information. Real mining assets in the language of global capital markets. Verifiable on chain. Join Unity.

records.name: Red Rili Shrimp
records.tagline: Stunning freshwater dwarf shrimp
records.description: The Red Rili Shrimp featuring vibrant red coloration on its head and tail, contrasted by a translucent white or clear middle section, this attractive variety brings a unique combination of colour and elegance to planted aquariums and shrimp collections.

records.name: Flawless UI/UX
records.tagline: Better UI/UX for AI coding agents
records.description: flawless-ui-ux is a free, open-source skill that helps AI coding agents build more thoughtful, polished, and usable interfaces. It works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, and other coding agents, guiding them through layout, typography, spacing, colors, accessibility, and visual consistency.

records.name: Finchb
records.tagline: A simple Solana wallet for the web, phone and Telegram
records.description: Finchb is a wallet for the Solana blockchain that works in three places with one account: in the browser, as an app on your phone or computer without an app store, and inside Telegram. Create a wallet with one tap, no email needed. Send and receive SOL, USDC and other Solana tokens, including memecoins. Swap between SOL and USDC, top up with USDT, BTC, ETH or TON, or buy by card through outside providers. Nine languages, support in the chat.

records.name: Buy and Sell Car Parts - PartsHub
records.tagline: Search car parts by your exact make, model, year and engine
records.description: Search car parts by your exact make, model, year and engine — or post a public request and let sellers worldwide bid with a price and a collection date. You can also request a bunch of other services like car protection or car wash.

records.name: Travel Archive
records.tagline: Map your trips. Turn your photos into travel books.
records.description: Keep your travels in one place. Bring the places you've been, photos, and notes together on a personal map. Revisit old trips or record new ones, then design your own travel book and export it as a PDF. Available on iOS and Android. No account required.

records.name: Pixel Pet
records.tagline: A tiny pixel desk pet that keeps you on task
records.description: Pixel Pet is a free, open source pixel pet for your Windows desktop. Type tasks in plain language ("standup weekdays 9:30"), run a Pomodoro focus timer with streaks, see live network speed and count the AI tokens you use in Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode. One 1.8 MB exe, about 18 MB of RAM, no account, no telemetry. Five pets, five themes.

records.name: Chainle
records.tagline: One word connects every clue. Five daily rounds.
records.description: Chainle is a free daily word connection game. Find one English word that links the clues across five untimed rounds, see how your connections score, and share your results. Keep exploring with unlimited practice or revisit earlier puzzles in the archive. Play in your browser with no account or app download needed.

records.name: NPC Filter
records.tagline: Filter AI slop on LinkedIn, X and Reddit, and see why
records.description: The AI-post filter that shows its work. NPC Filter is a free Chrome extension that spots likely AI-written posts on LinkedIn, X and Reddit and blurs, labels or hides them. Every flag names the signs it found, like "Not X, but Y" framing or stiff "serves as" phrasing, taken from Wikipedia editors' guide to spotting AI writing. Local rules run in your browser, free, with no account. Sign in for model checks on posts the rules miss. Only post text is ever checked. Reveal any post in one click.

records.name: Bidstage
records.tagline: Search open public-sector tenders in 70 countries, free
records.description: Bidstage searches open public-sector tenders and RFPs from the EU, UK, US federal (SAM.gov), Canada, the World Bank and several US states and cities, and matches them to your business. Free: unlimited keyword search, one tracked profile, daily or weekly alerts, no card required. Paid from $19/month: AI bid/no-bid scoring, document summaries, draft generation, CSV export and team collaboration. An alternative to enterprise tools like GovWin IQ, which can cost $8,000-$20,000/year for one seat.

records.name: DropWire
records.tagline: Fan-verified merch drop alerts
records.description: DropWire watches official artist and brand merch stores and alerts you when something new drops. Paid members get a text within seconds, plus push, email and Discord. Free accounts get push alerts about 30 minutes after a drop. Every alert links to the official store, not a reseller. Fans report sold-outs and false alarms, and those reports feed a trust score that shapes future alerts. 500+ artists across pop, K-pop, hip-hop, rock and country. $59/yr.

records.name: Invoicepak
records.tagline: Branded PDF invoices for every Shopify order, automatically
records.description: Automatically email branded PDF invoices for every order. Design custom invoice templates with drag and drop, then print, download, or resend in bulk.

records.name: Robod
records.tagline: Crypto Strategy making and Signals automation
records.description: Study the market, test a rule on real historical data, and get an alert when that condition appears. Automate crypto trading signals and strategy.

records.name: Asemaverse
records.tagline: Vos outils professionnels dans un seul endroit
records.description: Convertir, renommer, compresser et zipper vos fichiers en quelques secondes, dans un espace de travail simple et rapide.

records.name: Spark
records.tagline: Turn your idea into a business
records.description: Spark is the fastest way to go from idea to your first customer. Instead of just building an app, Spark helps you build the whole business - from sites and hosting, to accounts and payments, to emails, marketing, and the backend tools you need to run your business.

records.name: Komrad
records.tagline: The AI agent that does not work for you
records.description: Western agents book your flights and write your emails. Komrad will do none of that. A working AI chat from a fictional Soviet ministry. Free, no login, 10 ration coupons a day. Sound on.

records.name: Boondok
records.tagline: Find your next campsite
records.description: Explore campgrounds across Western Canada on one map. Real site details, photos and reviews, plus alerts when booked-out sites open up.

records.name: LiteDAW
records.tagline: A free pocket studio for vocals, synths and drums
records.description: Turn an idea into a song on your phone. Import a backing track, record vocals and alternate takes, arrange clips, play keys and drums, add built-in effects, and export your mix. LiteDAW is a free mobile recording studio for iPhone and Android that works locally, with no account required.

records.name: Folder
records.tagline: One folder on your Mac, iPhone and the web, on Cloudflare R2
records.description: Folder is one folder in Finder, in the Files app and on the web. Drag a file in and it's on every device, and every overwrite and delete stays restorable. Start free with 5 GB on Folder, or connect your own Cloudflare account: your files stay in your R2 buckets, at R2's price, and never pass through us. Drop a file on the menu bar icon and its link is on your clipboard.

records.name: Ghibli Photo
records.tagline: Turn a photo into a Ghibli-inspired portrait
records.description: Ghibli Photo turns a personal photo into a soft, hand-painted, Ghibli-inspired illustration. Try Soft watercolor free, no account needed. It is an independent tool and is not affiliated with Studio Ghibli.

records.name: Schulte Table Game
records.tagline: The classic Schulte table for focus and peripheral vision
records.description: A grid of shuffled numbers: tap 1, 2, 3... in order as fast as you can while your eyes stay on the centre. The classic Schulte exercise trains attention and peripheral vision - a good two-minute warm-up before reading or work. Time and training modes, 3x3 to 7x7 (up to 11x11 in the full version), letters, five colour schemes and the classic Schulte statistics. Free on Android.

records.name: Simple Bussiness calcualtor
records.tagline: calculator, bussiness, profit,
records.description: Calculate marketplace commissions, payment processing fees, shipping, VAT, break-even thresholds, and unit margins in seconds. Track your full product catalog in your browser—completely free, with no account required.

records.name: CLAT Rank Predictor
records.tagline: Calculate Your Estimated Rank Instantly!
records.description: The CLAT Rank Predictor is a free online tool designed to help CLAT aspirants estimate their rank based on their exam score. By entering your marks (out of 120), the tool provides an approximate rank, using trends from previous CLAT exams. This gives you valuable insights into your performance, helping you gauge your chances of securing admission to top NLUs.

records.name: Baru Day
records.tagline: Daily cycle telemetry powered by NASA JPL & Babylonian math
records.description: Zero-superstition daily cycle reports. Powered by 100+ years of NASA JPL hourly ephemerides and classical Babylonian algorithms, Baru Day translates planetary kinematics and solar telemetry into practical daily decisions.

records.name: AquaMind
records.tagline: AI swim coach that explains what's wrong with your stroke
records.description: Most swim apps hand you a workout. AquaMind explains why. Tell the coach how your swimming feels, and it tells you what's happening in the water, why, and how to fix it, in plain language. It's built on the method of a coach who has prepared national champions. • Ask anything about technique, breathing or training • Weekly plan built around your level and schedule • Pool Mode with interval timer • 32 Champions' Drills (Pro, 7-day free trial) • English, French, Russian

records.name: GetKeepsake
records.tagline: A shop website, QR and WhatsApp orders in one scan
records.description: Lots of small shops in India run on paper menus and WhatsApp. Customers ask "price kya hai?", prices change by hand, and regulars are forgotten. GetKeepsake gives any local shop (café, salon, kirana, boutique, clinic, gym) a mobile page behind one QR: • Menu or products with prices and photos • Orders straight to WhatsApp, UPI payments • Loyalty stamp card and Google reviews • Sales counter with GST bills, udhaar khata • Owner app with order alerts ₹1,000 once. Printed QR board included.

records.name: Studio Kit Free Core
records.tagline: Website launch checks and defensive hooks for Claude Code
records.description: A free MIT-licensed Claude Code plugin for developers building websites. Three skills cover browser launch QA, defensive pre-launch checks and concrete copy. Two pattern-based hooks flag recognized production deploys and common exposed-secret patterns. It saves local reports and screenshots; browser QA needs Playwright. These are guardrails, not a sandbox or a guarantee. Pro skills are a separate, optional product. Independent MEG Web Studio project, not endorsed by Anthropic.

records.name: Smarty Counsel
records.tagline: Your Trusted Accounting Firm in the UAE
records.description: Smarty Counsel is an accounting firm in Dubai, UAE, offering accounting services, bookkeeping for small businesses, VAT registration and return filing, corporate tax registration support, corporate tax consultancy, audit preparation, financial reporting, and outsourced accounting. Companies searching for an accountant in Dubai, a VAT consultant in the UAE, bookkeeping services, or corporate tax support can explore assistance suited to their needs. https://smartycounsel.com/

records.name: TynRent
records.tagline: Rental availability, reservations and returns on Windows
records.description: Manage equipment rentals on Windows 11. Check availability by date and quantity, confirm reservations, and record check-outs and returns. Track damaged or missing items, create customer quote PDFs, and keep business data on your PC with backup, restore and CSV exports. Built for small equipment and event rental businesses. Free trial available. One-time purchase with a perpetual license for the purchased version. No subscription.

records.name: Akatora Cloud Tiger Sukajan Jacket
records.tagline: Wear the Roar. Own the Streets.
records.description: Akatora Cloud Tiger Sukajan Jacket The Akatora Cloud Tiger Sukajan Jacket brings the strength of traditional tiger imagery into a clean Japanese souvenir jacket silhouette. A large roaring tiger dominates the back, embroidered in burnt orange, black, ivory, and warm beige tones. Beneath and around the tiger sit sweeping cream-colored Japanese cloud motifs, while small pink sakura blossoms add subtle contrast.

records.name: LeadScorer Outbound ROI Calculator
records.tagline: Model outbound ROI before you spend
records.description: Model what a B2B outbound campaign could return using your own costs and conversion rates. Start with booked meetings or qualified held meetings. See upfront cash, six-month customer value and campaign costs. Export the full calculation as a CSV. Free, with no signup.

records.name: Metronome.fm
records.tagline: A metronome for web, iPhone & iPad with voice control & AI
records.description: A metronome for your browser, iPhone and iPad. Start free with no sign-up; sign in and your settings, playlists and practice log follow you across devices. • Ramp the tempo up every few bars • Build beats on a 16th-note grid or layer polyrhythms • Voice control: “Hey Friko, set the BPM to 90 and play” • Ask AI for a song’s BPM, or measure a recording • SYNC the same beat across devices for band practice • Practice log with streaks

records.name: Snow Day Forecaster
records.tagline: The chance your school closes tomorrow, by US ZIP code
records.description: Enter a US ZIP code and see the percentage chance your school closes or goes remote tomorrow and over the next few days. The model was trained on how 20 large districts actually decided in winter 2025-26, then back-tested on 1,345 school days (Brier score 0.033). It weighs snow and ice on the ground, new frozen precipitation, wind chill and region. Free, no sign-up, and your ZIP stays in your browser.

records.name: GEOHATS
records.tagline: Get your brand recommended by ChatGPT and AI search
records.description: GEOHATS is an all-in-one tool that gets your brand recommended in ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini and Grok by: tracking the questions your buyers ask AI and showing the ones you lose; writing the page built to win each one and publishing it to your site; fixing your site so AI crawlers can read it, in one click; and automated outreach to get mentions on the sites AI trusts. One-time license, your own AI keys.

records.name: Stow
records.tagline: Stow: backups in plain English
records.description: Stow keeps a folder on your computer and a folder on another drive or a NAS the same. Pick two folders, say what should happen and when, and Stow says the whole plan back in one sentence. The first run shows every file it would copy, replace or remove, and anything it replaces or removes is kept for 30 days. For Mac (Apple silicon) and Windows 11. $39 once for 3 computers, with a 14-day trial that has everything working. And yes, there is a dark mode.

records.name: Scroll Findings
records.tagline: Everything worth keeping from your feed, sorted
records.description: Spotted something while scrolling, then lost it in your Saved folder? Forward any Instagram reel or post to @scrollfindings, or share YouTube videos and screenshots to the app. Scroll Findings works out what each one is and files it where you'll look for it: cafés and travel spots on your map, events to add to your calendar, recipes to cook, movies to watch, and more categories as we add them. Search in plain words, like “biryani near me open now”. Free on iPhone, Android and the web.

records.name: Tacie
records.tagline: Meeting notes on your Mac, with no bot in the call
records.description: Someone asks, "Why did we decide this?" and no one remembers. The answer is somewhere in a doc from months ago. Tacie listens on your Mac, with no bot in the call. When a question like that comes up, it looks up the answer in your past meetings and connected tools like Notion, Jira and Linear, and shows the answer and its source during the meeting. When the meeting ends, Tacie writes up the decisions, to-dos and open questions.

records.name: Dex Semantics
records.tagline: Let your agent build analytics with 25% fewer errors
records.description: Dex Semantics adds declarations to your analytical models, which capture row meaning, join nature, how numbers add up, and decisional assumptions. Thanks to this, Dex scores 80% on ADE-bench with Claude Sonnet 5.5, compared to 73.3% without Dex (25% fewer tasks failed). Declarations live in your models as code, not a third-party tool. Dex then helps your agent convert declarations into your Semantic Layer of choice.

records.name: Dynamic Edge
records.tagline: The Dynamic Island for Windows
records.description: Dynamic Edge brings a Dynamic Island-style experience to Windows 10 and 11. It combines media controls, clipboard history, app and folder launching, timers, volume controls, and more into a lightweight floating interface. Built with native WinUI 3 and Windows App SDK, it is designed to feel at home on Windows without the overhead of Electron. You can dock it to the top, left, or right of your screen, use it across multiple monitors, and quickly summon it with a global hotkey or Magic Shake.

records.name: Signal Trading Bot Development
records.tagline: Signal Trading Bot Development for Automated Trading
records.description: Signal Trading Bot Development focuses on building automated trading systems that execute trades based on predefined market signals. The development process includes technical indicator integration, signal generation, strategy configuration, exchange API connectivity, automated order execution, and real time market monitoring. Custom trading bots support configurable trading rules, multi exchange integration, and performance tracking for different trading strategies.

records.name: Goftito
records.tagline: AI studio for translation, voice, video and research
records.description: Goftito is an AI studio for Persian speakers. Translate documents, images and subtitles into 10 languages and get the same file back, layout intact. Turn text into natural Persian speech or your own voice, make a podcast from a topic, and dub videos with a new voice for every speaker. Students can turn a thesis into defense slides, a talk and likely examiners' questions, or write a paper from their own research. Everyday PDF and image tools are included. Start free with 500 credits.
